scenario.title: Rooftop PV buy with optional BESS and supplier clarification
scenario.summary: The real Shelter Island package requires a rooftop PV system and treats BESS as an additive optional alternate. Controlled clarification establishes budget/schedule, and one supplier asks whether the BESS alternate is mandatory before quoting itemized PV/BESS pricing.

realism.notes: The rooftop PV requirement, 480 V three-phase interconnection, and BESS-as-additive-alternate structure are frozen public facts. Budget, schedule, supplier behavior, and prices are synthetic.

objective.description: Reach an award-ready procurement decision without violating the real starting requirements or synthetic scenario facts revealed during the episode.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic Shelter Island Solar Supplier A
suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic Shelter Island Solar Supplier B
suppliers.notes: Asks whether the optional BESS must be included before quoting.

suppliers.display_name: Synthetic Shelter Island Solar Supplier C
suppliers.notes: Synthetic supplier used only inside this episode.

events.observation: Synthetic buyer clarification: base PV budget ceiling USD 450,000 and commissioning within 180 days; the BESS remains an optional additive alternate.
Supplier A quotes the required PV system for USD 420,000 with 160-day commissioning.
Supplier B asks whether the BESS additive alternate is mandatory for award.

details.question: Is the BESS additive alternate mandatory?

events.observation: After confirmation that BESS is optional, Supplier B quotes PV at USD 390,000 and an optional integrated BESS at USD 110,000, both with 150-day commissioning.
Supplier C quotes the required PV system for USD 405,000 but requires 190 days.

hard_constraints.description: Missing commercial terms and optional-BESS treatment must be clarified before RFQ.
Awarded required PV scope must interconnect at 480 V and be a complete PV system.
Required PV price must not exceed USD 450,000.
Required PV commissioning must be within 180 days.
The required PV line item must be awarded exactly once; the BESS alternate may be omitted or awarded at most once.

acceptable_terminal_outcomes.rationale: Supplier B provides the lowest-price feasible required PV scope; the optional BESS is not required for award.
Supplier A provides a feasible required PV scope at a higher price.
Supplier B can also provide the optional integrated BESS, but including the optional alternate raises total awarded price.

failure_conditions: Treating the optional BESS as mandatory.
Awarding Supplier C despite the 190-day schedule.
Failing to answer Supplier B's material scope question.

economic_objective.description: Among acceptable feasible terminal outcomes, prefer the lowest total awarded price.
